html:
Ring of Fire
Skill Type:  Offensive
Trainer:  Mage
Number of Ranks:  15
Cost to Max:  ?
Fires multiple fire bolts in 360 degree radius

Ring of Fire is sometimes referred to as RoF Burns up to 12 enemies by sending out a wave of fire bolts in a 360 degree radius. Each bolt deals Fire Damage and has a chance to inflict additional Fire Damage over 3 seconds.

Cool down: 8 Seconds


This is skill in particular can do serious amounts of damage. The damage potential relies on hitting targets with the actual bolts. On some larger targets, like Rotgut for instance, maximum damage can be inflicted with this skill, by simply casting RoF while INSIDE the target. Several bolts or all bolts can hit inflicting the bolts' initial damage however, it is unknown if the Damage Over Time (DoT) of the bolts that do connect are inflicted once per bolt or just once.

As of Build 121, DoT effects for this skill may now stack once for each player in your group.
